facts.fact: KRAY 连续四天上午和下午都去总部星巴克找 BUTTONFLY，最终在 4 月 16 日星期五下午 4:30 看到他坐在后桌与一名年轻案件官员交谈。
facts.anchor: Over the next four days KRAY looked for BUTTONFLY every morning and afternoon down at the Headquarters Starbucks. Finally, at 4:30 p.m. on Friday, April 16, KRAY spotted him sitting at a table in the back talking with a young case officer.

facts.fact: KRAY 说 Wacker 似乎不知道他把 Wacker 的秘密 GOOWIKI/Operation Kitchen Appliance 备忘录交给 D. B. Cooper、再由 Cooper 转给 Skinner。
facts.anchor: He doesn’t seem to know I gave his secret GOOWIKI/Operation Kitchen Appliance memo to D. B. Cooper to give to Skinner.

facts.fact: KRAY 说他们现在把他安排在 Penalty Box，并且 Wacker 已将他转介给 Counterespionage Group（反间谍组）。
facts.anchor: But now they have me sitting in the Penalty Box. And Wacker has referred me to the Counterespionage Group.

facts.fact: BUTTONFLY 说 CEG 里没有严肃的人，但 CEG 把自己看得很重；查不出东西时他们就会捏造。
facts.anchor: Even though there are no serious people working there, CEG takes itself very seriously. If they can’t find anything, they’ll fudge it.

facts.fact: KRAY 谎称自己念的是杜克大学，BUTTONFLY 称杜克为“南方的耶鲁法学院”。
facts.anchor:
“Duke,” KRAY fibbed.

“Ah, fair Duke,” said BUTTONFLY. “The Yale Law of the South.”

facts.fact: BUTTONFLY 说自己本科和法学院都念耶鲁，成绩是“稳稳的 C”。
facts.anchor: Yep. Undergraduate too. Double-barreled. Solid Cs, by the way.

facts.fact: BUTTONFLY 承认自己是骷髅会成员，示范秘密问候：张嘴成圆圈，用指关节敲头顶，发出阴沉的回声。
facts.anchor: Then he opened his mouth, forming it into a circle. He rapped on the top of his skull with his knuckles, producing a lugubrious echo.

facts.fact: BUTTONFLY 建议 KRAY 照他们说的做、低调熬过去，并暂时切断与 Cooper 和 Skinner 的联系，两人之间的谈话也要暂停。
facts.anchor: You should probably break off contact with Cooper and Skinner for now though. And as for our conversations, we’d better take a break, too, until all this blows over.
